_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your real values. config.json is git-ignored and never committed. You can also set any of these via environment variables (same name, UPPERCASE) which take priority.

zoho._comment: From your Zoho API console self-client. data_center is your Zoho domain: com (US), eu, in, com.au, jp.

anthropic._comment: Anthropic API key for the in-app Claude skills. Get one at console.anthropic.com.

printing._comment: printer_name is the exact Windows printer name. On non-Windows dev machines, leave blank to write .prn files into the out/ folder instead. Calibration offsets shift ALL printed text on pre-printed forms; tune them from the Calibration screen.
